record_kind: Revealing native failures prompted a real bounded geometry revision, not weakened enemies

failed_cases.observation: Both original objectives recovered with the mechanism untouched; the old market detour took damage and smoke expired before the final quay crossing. The player then died on the quay.
The quiet clinic opening avoided alerts, but the later exposed front aisle killed the player before the original deep lever.

design_revision: Move the lever from z=-14.5 to -10.3, nearer the front entrance.
Move the partition from z=-17.2 to -21.2, outside the watcher firing-distance relationship at the lever while retaining the occupancy interlock and both flanks.
Use the already built west terrace ramp for the no-mechanism approach; update the existing clinic letter to explain the meaningful east/west choice.
Join the south wall segment to its original edge without the accidental 0.5-metre gap.
test_revision: Classic uses its real finite smoke at the final quay, not prematurely.

Focused XR new-mechanism tests start normally and take the existing Freight-first eastern verge. This does not claim the failed long clinic-first XR prefix is repaired or that XR cases are full chapter completions.
Earlier under-eight-metre crossing criterion is explicitly revised to under ten because the entrance-side lever is about 8.9 navigation metres from the exit.
Only one VR controller case captures before/after through the public pause function and a simulated spectator pose; no actor or mission state is rewritten.
preserved: Enemy damage/ranges, perception, health, resource costs and inventories, movement speeds, saves, input bindings and legal extraction stay unchanged.
remaining: Unfamiliar-player choice comprehension and physical XR usability remain unapproved.
